title: smart bucking buckets
description: this mod auto stacks empty buckets to save space
body:
this mod auto stacks empty buckets to save space

i made this mod for my personal use cuz i make a lot of farms and i find it really annoying that empty water buckets dont auto stack

this mod was made in Mcreator
